launches.title: UpCodes - Copilot for building codes
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** UpCodes Copilot accelerates building code research for anyone involved in the compliance process for design and construction by providing tailored responses and relevant regulations to project-specific questions.

# **Managing compliance is difficult**

In today’s complex regulatory environment, compliance management is critical in ensuring safety in our built environments. However, as these codes become more comprehensive, they become more challenging to manage and meet. Homeowners, developers, architects, engineers, builders, and government officials spend significant amounts of time dissecting and working with the code. 

The code ecosystem is not only incredibly dense but also constantly changing. We host over 5 million code sections and 1,700+ state and city codes, [update over 7,000 sections per month (on average)](https://up.codes/code-accuracy), and host over 160,000 local amendments. Other challenges include the difficulty of working across multiple jurisdictions and maintaining firm-wide code expertise. 

# **Current AI tools are limited**

Generic AI chatbots (like ChatGPT, Google Bard, Bing Chat, etc.) work from out-of-date code and is not jurisdiction-specific. Because the codes change dramatically across adoption cycles and jurisdictions, for many codes, UpCodes is often the only place that is continually integrating local amendments or changes to the code.

# **Introducing UpCodes Copilot**

At UpCodes, we envision a world where architects, engineers, contractors, and everyone involved in the building compliance lifecycle can work together seamlessly and harness the power of AI to create safer buildings. We’re in the early innings of that future, and it’s why we’re excited to announce UpCodes Copilot. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72667&key=user_uploads/147166/5481c27f-f364-4ce9-9449-de817a1bf363)

Our vision is that Copilot becomes an indispensable research assistant for designers, builders, plan reviewers, and plan examiners. Instead of manually parsing through dense code sections, Copilot accelerates code research process by instantly delivering tailored responses to any code query. With Copilot you can: 

* **Research faster** – Go beyond manually gathering code sections from various codes and chapters. 
* **Be more efficient** – Catch sections you may have missed and better manage compliance. 
* **Gain insight** – Unlock the ability to parse through massive quantities of code.

# **Who Copilot is for**

UpCodes Copilot is for anyone involved in the code compliance lifecycle. Most architects, engineers, and general contractors already know how cumbersome and difficult it is to gather context and gain insight into what the code is saying. Wherever someone is in the architectural design process, whether they’re designing, building, or managing occupancy, Copilot will accelerate their understanding of the code.

# **How Copilot works**

Copilot builds on our powerful search that surfaces relevant content across our 5+ million code sections by directly answering tough code questions. Its responses are based on analysis across multiple code sections (including tables and charts!) as well as basic calculations. And best yet, Copilot always cites the sections it pulls from so anyone can validate the response and deepen their code expertise.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72667&key=user_uploads/147166/1e0ce9d8-73f1-4e6b-9527-6641b8b15322)

([video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=695G3xNKk_o))

# **What you can use Copilot for**

* **Ask a code question** – Ask code questions for a specific jurisdiction and adoption cycle and get answers that point out the relevant code sections.\
  Example: “I have a parking lot with 200 spaces. How many van-accessible spaces do I need?”
* **Explain a concept or code section** – Get detailed explanations for complex concepts or specific code sections. \
  Example: “Can you explain what 'fire separation distance' means in the context of building code?"‍
* **Find related sections** – Identify code sections that correspond to a specific topic you’re researching. \
  Example: "Find all sections related to plumbing codes in a residential building."
* **Perform a calculation** – Provide your project parameters to Copilot and let it calculate the code requirements for you. \
  Example: “Help me determine the maximum occupancy of a building, given its size…”‍
* **Summarize what the code is saying** – For lengthy code sections, ask Copilot to give you an overview of the key points.\
  Example: "Summarize the key points from Section 101.2 of CBC 2022."‍
* **Generate a checklist for a focus area** – Get a tailored checklist for that specific focus area to help you ensure all requirements are met. \
  Example: “Provide a checklist for designing a Type 1 grease duct for a fryer in a commercial kitchen. The kitchen is on the ground floor of a 3-story building. Ventilation equipment will be placed on the roof.”

# **Ask**

* If you would like to try Copilot, sign up for an [UpCodes trial](https://upcodes.ai) to test it out for free! 
* If you know of any architecture, engineering, or general contracting firms, we would love to chat! You can reach us at [sales@up.codes](mailto:sales@up.codes).

long_description:
Aurelian builds AI tools that help 911 centers handle more with less, so telecommunicators can stay focused on what matters most and communities get the response they need.

AVA is a conversational AI agent that answers non-emergency calls; the agent routes, triages, and resolves the calls without any human intervention. By handling administrative calls like noise complaints, lost dogs, and parking inquiries, AVA eliminates hold times and lets call-takers focus their energy on actual emergencies.

CORA supports call-takers on the calls that matter most. CORA is an on-screen assistant that delivers real-time SOP checklists, smart reminders, and contextual guidance as an emergency call unfolds, so dispatchers stay calm, consistent, and confident when every second counts. When AVA detects an emergency mid-call, it transfers the caller to a telecommunicator and passes along the caller details, location, incident type, and key statements directly into CORA. The call-taker never starts from scratch.

The problem we're solving is serious. The average emergency communications center is 30% understaffed nationwide. Staffing shortages drive burnout and attrition, which makes the shortage worse. Meanwhile, 60-80% of the calls coming in aren't even emergencies at all. Aurelian addresses both sides of that equation: AVA reduces unnecessary call volume, and CORA makes every emergency call more manageable for the people handling it.


Aurelian is live in centers across the country, answering thousands of non-emergency calls every day, and is backed by New Enterprise Associates and Y Combinator. Aurelian is growing rapidly; we are hiring people who want to help scale this work and make a real difference in public safety infrastructure for communities across the country.

launches.tagline: Making government efficient by fixing procurement
launches.body:
### 📝 **BLUF** 

Hazel is the _only AI-native solution_ which enables public sector procurement teams to seamlessly define requirements, generate solicitations, conduct market research, and evaluate responses in one place. Public sector procurement is a time-intensive process held together by Microsoft Office, legacy point solutions, tribal knowledge, and severely overworked civil servants. Hazel is building an AI-powered platform to accelerate and streamline this mission. 

We’ve engaged hundreds of government agencies with diverse missions, and we’ve been hard at work building something they want. We’re already on contract with several governments and have received funding from agencies ranging from public school districts to the U.S. Navy!

If you know anyone supporting government procurement, please contact us! 

### 🦅 **About Us + What’s New** 

We’re Elton and August, and we along with our 3 amazing founding software engineers currently operate out of NYC, Boston, DC, and Salt Lake City. We’re excited to (finally) re-launch Hazel, an AI-native solution **which enables government procurement teams to quickly and easily manage their procurement processes**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87095&key=user_uploads/1279709/df8d3560-f897-4131-b217-b9a76fc3525c)

The two of us met in college before taking separate jobs at Palantir and Boston Consulting Group, but our focus on public service remained the same, and we saw something that we knew had to be fixed. Along the way, we’ve picked up incredible mission-driven teammates with experience from Lockheed Martin, MITRE, SpaceX, Peraton, the U.S. Air Force, the U.S. Department of State, and USAID. 

We began by building a solution for businesses to bid on RFPs because we wanted to help governments. The idea was that by bringing more businesses to the table, more competitive bids would both save governments money and deliver better performance. However, we soon realized that if our mission was to help government, we will best accomplish that by going directly B2G, not B2B2G. It means accepting the known challenges of selling to government as a startup (long sales cycles, a litany of compliance standards, nobody returns your emails, a new language of business, etc.), but nothing worthwhile - or fulfilling - comes easy.

### 🏛**️ Problem** 

Civil servants in procurement are overwhelmed. \~30% of procurement roles in government are unfilled as these employees retire or quit. Their current solutions are dated – one to two _decades_ behind the equivalent in B2B SaaS, gated behind sleepy incumbents leveraging political connections and litigation to stay on top. The lack of tools and talent means governments are more stretched than ever when it comes to buying the goods and services they need in a compliant and timely manner. This challenge is eating away at all levels of government, from local K-12 school districts to the Pentagon. As prices rise and the demands on governments grow, it becomes even more critical to strategically purchase the right tools for their success. Failure means degradation in service delivery, bad publicity, or even disaster. 

A maze of legal restrictions, understaffed departments, and growing complexity of requirements have made it near impossible to rapidly procure goods and services without defaulting to an existing incumbent. Governments would love to diversify their options or recompete… but choosing the default has shifted from a matter of convenience to an operational necessity. Over $2.7T is on the line for public procurement _annually._ 

There has never been a more pressing – or opportune – time to address the procurement challenges taxing our government’s efficiency. Climate goals require rapidly procuring sustainable and efficient energy solutions nationwide. The new era of great power competition requires procuring novel weapon systems at scale to secure democracies in the Pacific and Eastern Europe. Our aging procurement systems are creaking under their weight and cannot unlock the potential of our nation.

### 🔥 **Solution** 

Hazel’s platform accelerates and automates the rote, time-intensive tasks of researching, generating and managing solicitations. Instead of trading documents over email and doing market research via cursory Google searches, civil servants should have a single streamlined platform that assists them in doing their jobs. 

Hazel combines AI agents and a modern UI/UX to deliver a consumer-grade solution that surfaces critical information to human decision-makers, saving time and driving better outcomes. Hazel is the AI superpower for procurement teams short on staff and time but hungry for innovation and a way to do things better.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87095&key=user_uploads/1279709/ce5def23-288b-44fe-baa4-39c4fb09bcb8)

_(Screenshot of the Hazel platform) Save legal-approved boilerplates, design content sections using our AI agents, and drag-and-drop them into templates. Compliant first-draft solicitations using the agency’s template in five minutes, not five months. Edit collaboratively in real-time and seamlessly export to Word when done. No copy-paste required._ 

### **🫡 Asks**

Contracts are separately issued by governments, and responses must meet long lists of criteria to be compliant and award-eligible, making them immensely hard and time-consuming to write. Hazel breaks down that moat.

If you or anyone you know wants to get matched to or respond to government RFPs, please [contact us](mailto:elton@hazeltech.ai?cc=august@hazeltech.ai)!

### **🥷 About Us**

We’re [Elton](https://linkedin.com/in/eltonlossner) and [August](https://linkedin.com/in/augustschen), in SF for this YC W24 batch. We’re excited to announce Hazel, an AI-driven marketplace **that enables businesses to quickly respond to issued government RFPs in a compliant manner**.

Use AI to automate discovery, drafting, and compliance. Instead of spending days trawling local websites and weeks writing fruitless proposals, you should only spend minutes defining your scope of work and price.

Use Hazel to get matched to a potential contract, synthesize a draft response based on the RFP and your company information, create a checklist of to-dos, and run compliance checks. No more scrambling to register your company the day before submission. No more losing a bid because you missed a cybersecurity requirement listed on page 13 of Appendix G.

# **🚀 Introduction**

Hey everyone! We’re Anthony and Connor, aka the [Ontra Mobility](https://www.ontramobility.com/) team, and we’re revolutionizing how people move.

## **❗ The Problem**

Transit agencies in the U.S. are facing massive budget shortfalls (up to $3B). Agencies need to adapt their transit systems more quickly to meet the demands of our evolving cities. Work from home led to a large drop in ridership, which is problematic for train and bus routes, which have high fixed costs. Cutting lines or reducing frequency further impacts ridership - transit agencies need a different solution.

## **💡 The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83029&key=user_uploads/1627714/d71e126f-1b4c-4fa4-b902-3e1e5f0e05bd)

Ontra helps cities and other transit agencies increase ridership through data-driven planning and real-time optimization. Our platform optimizes cost and rider experience by designing high-frequency bus routes and ridesharing zones, where our algorithms adapt routes to demand in real time.

## **⚙️ How It Works**

Ontra analyzes information about where people live, how they've traveled in the past, and the existing transit system to figure out the best way to redesign the transit network.

Once the improvements are made, Ontra Mobility plans rider journeys in real-time with the best combination of transit options available, whether it’s a train, bus, bike, or agency-operated on-demand. Our system can handle thousands of ridesharing requests per minute – efficiently assigning riders to optimal routes.

Hey everyone! We are [Sam](https://linkedin.com/in/samcrombie) and [Adam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-mcquilkin/) building Actionbase. Actionbase builds tools that make the web agent-interpretable. Today, we are launching our first product, the [Web Action SDK](https://actionbase.co/).

# **TL;DR**

The [Web Action SDK](https://actionbase.co/) is a TypeScript / JavaScript SDK that lets developers run automations on popular websites with only a few lines of code.

# **What’s the problem?**

Web automations, particularly for high-traffic websites, **suck to build and maintain**. Yet engineering teams find themselves having to build them from scratch, over and over.

Spinning your own automations is an easy path to unnecessarily complex codebases and enormous tech debt. Automations break down, hit edge cases, and become exponentially unruly.

But this is business-critical functionality, so what else can you do?

# **Solution: Web Action SDK**

We’ve built an SDK that allows you to run automations on popular sites with only a few lines of code. Simply add your API key, define an action, and run it.

Here’s how you can use our SDK to send a LinkedIn message.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83184&key=user_uploads/448194/5978c043-af17-4af7-8b20-5c3ef74d7277)

Now that you’ve made your plans, you can use other services supported by the SDK to prepare for dinner: buy a notebook to take notes (Amazon), make a restaurant reservation (Resy), and get a ride to the restaurant (Uber).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83184&key=user_uploads/448194/5875c5ac-d64a-4bb7-9f1f-0eddf8b25a95)

In less than 10 lines of code, you’ve planned a pretty cool night out.

# **Value Proposition: Simplicity**

Web Action SDK does all the heavy-lifting for you: authentication, anti-botting, task creation and execution, self-healing, and hosting. Our goal is to enable engineering teams to focus on **what to do with web actions**, not how to make them work.

launches.body:
Hi! We are Lucas and Paul, cofounders of Tire Swing: the AI compliance platform for Affordable Housing.

<https://youtu.be/x4qyhXXz38I>

## **The Problem**

Every Affordable Housing move-in and recertification requires applicant income verification and a strict eligibility review. In addition to the high labor costs and regulatory burden, delays in reviewing applications and thoroughly screening applicants can cause weeks of lost rental revenue.

Lost revenue on a single move-in can accumulate to thousands of dollars, and penalties for non-compliance can cost millions in credit recaptures and fines.

## **The Solution**

Tire Swing uses AI to bring compliance expertise to the point of leasing. It turns weeks of reviews and approvals into a minutes-long process. The platform:

* **Reviews evidence as it is collected.** Tire Swing processes documentation in minutes, allowing problems to be addressed before the applicant leaves the office.
* **Performs the eligibility analysis.** It calculates household income, applies all applicable property, state, and program eligibility rules, and links every finding to its supporting evidence.
* **Automates certification compliance.** Tire Swing flags missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information with steps to resolve the problem from a library of thousands of deterministic and AI driven compliance checks.

**Tire Swing means faster move-ins and recertifications, reduced consulting budget, and more consistent, audit-ready files.** 

## **Looking ahead**

We believe Affordable Housing is the first application of a much larger needs-based eligibility opportunity. Federal, state, and local governments distribute more than $1.5 trillion annually through needs-based programs including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, utility assistance, and tax credits.

These programs share a common underlying workflow: collect documents, convert them into structured facts, apply eligibility rules, and resolve missing or contradictory information.  The administration costs for these services are approximately $20B annually.

## **The Team**

Tire Swing is founded by Paul and Lucas, college friends and Princeton computer science graduates. Prior to founding Tire Swing, Lucas worked as a software engineer at Instacart and Capital One, and Paul worked as a cybersecurity consultant at Stroz Friedberg.

Hi! We’re [Gordy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gordysun/) and [Justin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justin2028/). We’re excited to publicly announce what we’ve been building at Lakonia.

**TL;DR:** Lakonia’s AI Command and Control platform acts as a tactical assistant by listening to radio communications and using AI to automatically extract key intel, map units, and recommend actions. We give first-responder, law enforcement, and military teams the situational awareness they need to make better, faster decisions.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DrVPw4CVzxU

# **The Problem:**

Police and military command and control technology is terribly archaic and outdated. Commanders in a central post rely almost entirely on fragmented radio chatter to understand complex situations, forcing them to build a mental picture from scratch on every incident/situation. And current software is woefully outdated - unintelligent and unintuitive.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95135&key=user_uploads/2944902/726ea501-6ff8-446d-9b30-a7fc9a3028fd)

These issues only get exacerbated during multi-agency operations, where different departments (like SFPD and CHP), military branches, or even allied forces cannot communicate seamlessly. Communication siloes, different cultures of radio etiquette, chains of command, etc. all make command and control even more difficult.

And while at times this is just a daily annoyance, when it’s a matter of life or death, these communication breakdowns become **fatal**.

# **Lakonia’s Solution:**

Olympus is an **intelligent, real-time co-pilot** that plugs into existing radio networks, transforming chaotic voice chatter into a **clear, actionable operational picture.**

Our AI engine works in real time by:

**- Transcribing and diarizing** every transmission to identify who said what

**- Parsing transmissions** to analyze and automatically tag critical information - for example, pinpointing addresses on a map, logging license plates, and identifying calls for backup

**- Highlighting** the most urgent events and suggesting relevant next steps, **turning raw audio into structured intelligence**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95135&key=user_uploads/2944902/c78d42a9-f060-4024-a5e8-aac1466ad28d)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95135&key=user_uploads/2944902/4275d0a3-6853-4605-a15d-494eb39b5657)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95135&key=user_uploads/2944902/23e29921-35dc-449d-aa21-ea8880019c80)

We’ve also built a **mobile “Pip-boy” platform** for operators to access so that they can also be aware of what’s going on aside from their radio. This dual approach dramatically reduces the cognitive load on personnel at every level, empowering teams to make faster, smarter, and safer decisions when it matters most. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95135&key=user_uploads/2944902/5f679af9-289c-4cfb-80f3-fc8ba440b2e0)

For dispatchers and commanders, our software means less time spent clarifying details or trying to keep track of officer availability and statuses. For operators in the field, our software means less time waiting for dispatch to respond and better situational awareness in tactical environments.

We built Olympus with a deliberate focus on security, performance, and scalability. We rely on **no third party APIs**, allowing us to even operate in denied environments through mobile platforms. We are at FedRamp and CJIS-equivalent levels of compliance, utilizing AWS GovCloud for services. All the models we use are open-source models we fine-tuned ourselves.

This modular foundation allows us to rapidly integrate new capabilities. Our future roadmap includes advanced features like live drone feeds, computer vision analysis, and real-time language translation.

# **About Us:**

We’re two Stanford engineering students who left after our freshman year to go build the tools that our public safety and military teams deserve. In designing and building our platform, we were heavily inspired by RTS video games we’ve played as intuitive interfaces for delivering critical information to players. We wondered why law enforcement and the military don’t have similar tools and decided to go build them ourselves.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95135&key=user_uploads/2944902/353cbfd1-d5fd-42e6-9d2d-5abbe867d7bc)

# **Our Ask:**

We are looking for introductions to innovative leaders in public safety and defense who want to utilize our platform.

Our ideal contacts are decision-makers (e.g., Chiefs, Sheriffs, Commanding Officers, Heads of Security) in:

* Law Enforcement (Municipal Police, Sheriff's Offices, Transit/Campus Police)
* Military (Infantry, Artillery, Armor, National Guard, Special Operations units)
* Emergency Services (Fire, EMS)
* Private Security (Corporate campuses, large venues, critical infrastructure)

launches.body:
Today, when a city gets a public records request, the process is still painfully manual.

City clerks have to hunt through archived emails, meeting minutes, PDFs, and shared drives just to find the relevant records. Many offices still manually black out sensitive information with a Sharpie, line by line.

Local governments spend billions processing these requests. It’s slow, expensive, and a large request can create massive backlogs. If a city misses the deadline for a request, they can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.

GovGuard uses AI agents to automatically search across years of records, flag sensitive information for redaction, and prepare draft response letters for review. Our redaction engine handles harder edge cases like trade secrets and privileged material. Legacy tools require clerks to manually cite state codes for every redaction, while GovGuard is built with these exemptions.

The new surge of AI-generated requests are overwhelming clerk offices. Most cities we speak with are seeing request volume grow 2x year over year, with no increase in staff. The tools they have today are basically Jira. They help manage the ticket/request, but not complete the work.

launches.title: Verdant: helping cities process permits faster
launches.tagline: Modern permitting and planning software for local governments
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** 

Verdant is building the modern tech infrastructure for local government, and we’re starting with end-to-end permitting software that dramatically cuts local government permit review time. 

We help applicants file complete, compliant applications upfront, then help staff review them - our AI reads documents, plans, and diagrams, then flags issues and drafts the final report. 

**Launch Video**
[ ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1e5VeQc-NIrlNqIHZP-ASPhuE9DwUzouM/view?usp=sharing)
**Our story**

While studying international politics at Georgetown, I spent three years in and around government (Capitol Hill, then DOJ and Deloitte) and kept hitting the same wall: policy sets direction, but execution is throttled by legacy software. My co-founder Jason has worked in govtech for the past four years researching public benefits automation at Georgetown and building govtech products at Holly and Aidy (YC W24) for local governments.

Jason and I connected over our passion for improving local government processes. The people who keep cities running are stretched thin across understaffed offices, and we want to give them the capacity to do more of what they signed up for. After interviewing 200+ local government staff, we learned that permitting is one of their most painful processes and their software has not done enough to help.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104860&key=user_uploads/3242750/71ea38cf-11ee-427f-8a30-f9381d983c70)

**What we’ve heard**

Permit and entitlement review takes too long, and local government staff are overwhelmed. Applicants often apply with incorrect information, triggering rounds of back-and-forth with the government. And once complete materials are finally in, understaffed departments can’t review everything quickly enough. 

Pandemic-era incumbent contracts are churning because staff are frustrated with expensive legacy systems that only intake and track permits – no automation involved. Our end-to-end solution picks up where those systems stop, automating the review itself to fix permitting where it's most broken.

**What we’re building**

Say a homeowner wants to renovate their house. Before anything else, they have to figure out which permits and entitlements they need. Verdant starts here: applications chat with an AI agent trained on the city ordinances to determine what to apply for. From there, we route applications to a Turbo Tax-style permitting intake portal that guides them through the application, answers their questions, and flags gaps before submission, so what lands on the staff's desk is correct and compliant.

After submission, our AI helps building officials and planners run completeness checks on applications, flagging errors in site plans and drawings. When the application is approved, Verdant uses the context already gathered to draft the next deliverable, whether that's a staff report for the planning commission or a memo for city council.

Beyond the permit lifecycle, Verdant also supports long-range planning: our ordinance research tools let local governments compare how other jurisdictions have written their codes so they have reference points when updating their own.

**Our asks**

* Reach out! If you work in local government (planners, building officials, community developers, city managers, etc.) we’d love to chat.
* Spread the word! If you know anyone in the permitting or planning space, we’d love to connect with them.

 

**Contact us at [founders@verdantapp.com](mailto:founders@verdantapp.com)**

**TL;DR:** Chromie is the AI operating system for government contractors. We help teams find opportunities before the RFP drops, build the right relationships, test win strategies against real data, and draft winning proposals. All on top of a company brain that remembers everything your team has ever learned.

<https://youtu.be/6ZGxJlFgCgI>

\
**The problem**

The U.S. government is the largest buyer on earth, spending $800B on contracts every year. Yet the business is fundamentally relationship driven. Winning depends on understanding the agency, finding opportunities earlier than your competitors, and applying judgment built over years. 

Today, that work runs on gut instinct, fragmented tools, and institutional knowledge that disappears when people leave.

**What Chromie does**

Chromie surfaces agency signals and expiring contracts years before an RFP is posted publicly, giving capture teams time to understand the customer and shape a credible pursuit.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109881&key=user_uploads/2373564/7796de7e-c1c5-4a18-b1ce-7036de7414dc)

From there, teams can qualify opportunities, develop teaming and pricing strategies, and compare potential win strategies without wasting resources. Chromie’s PWin models are backtested against millions of verified award outcomes, helping teams augment intuition with evidence.

Once a team decides to bid, Chromie carries that strategy into proposal development. It maintains a **company brain** that connects capture, proposal, and contract-execution knowledge in one shared foundation, so each pursuit benefits from the company’s past experience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109881&key=user_uploads/2373564/899638cb-afd8-40d6-81c5-e625eba27b75)

What your team learns today strengthens the next pursuit.

Chromie already supports contractors with 100+ prime awards and more than $250M in obligated contract value. These teams have used Chromie to 3x their monthly proposal output and win new awards.

We're Ananth and Akshay. We met in a high school English class and have been building together ever since. Between us we've built and scaled infrastructure at Google, LinkedIn, Plaid, and Amazon. We’re developing Chromie alongside former federal contracting officers and acquisition leaders with decades of government experience.

* Government contractors, especially capture, BD, and proposal teams
* Startups and companies trying to break into government contracting

Contracts are won by the companies that start earliest, remember most, and test how to win instead of guessing. If that's you, or you're trying to get there, reach out.

Locke is building the front door government never had. We combine our AI agents with in-house lobbyists who own the entire path - from research to first meeting to funded contract. Since quietly launching six weeks ago, we've blown past a $500K annual revenue run-rate serving clients across defense, healthcare, GovTech, and more.
